curve_order: Per-condition/arm proposals ordered by immutable proposal creation time, matching sequential real rollout order.
failure_logging: Hash and manifest partial raw artifacts even if scientific runner returns an exception.
fixed_comparison: Choose coverage-first fixed descriptor separately within MATCHED and NATIVE; no cross-arm pooled ranking.
interruption: Single in-flight child did not finish during deliberate pre-B parent stop; original raw/status retained.
prior_inclusion: Match case/options/checkpoint hash; exclude continual pilot starts; classify arm by actual timing_policy/NATIVE_PATH, including historically mislabeled native confirmation headers.
prior_initialization: Known-good hip-leading restart uses strongest same-condition/arm prior isolated or native descriptor when exactly representable in this level/domain; otherwise original .12/.5 hip-leading seed. No oracle inputs, no value model calls, no new learning.
